articles.title: For Keri Russell, ‘The Diplomat’ Is a ‘Love Letter’ to the Foreign Service
articles.summary: Actress Keri Russell is discussing Season 2 of her Netflix series, 'The Diplomat.' The show portrays the complex world of career foreign-service officers and their political machinations in international relations. Russell finds the narrative 'insane,' highlighting the intricate global diplomacy. This series offers insights into the challenges faced by diplomats on the world stage, relevant for understanding international affairs.

articles.title: Navy preps science-and-tech strategy built for speed and focus
articles.summary: The Navy has launched a new science and technology strategy to accelerate the integration of advanced innovations into its fleet. This initiative will strategically allocate limited research funds, prioritizing unique defense challenges that private industry is unlikely to solve independently. The goal is to ensure critical technological advancements are pursued, maintaining a competitive edge and enhancing operational capabilities for the service.

articles.title: ‘It’s Not Competitive in Nature’
articles.summary: The text reviews Vinay Kwatra's two-year tenure as India's ambassador to the United States, highlighting significant shifts in Washington and the global order. It notes the considerable impact of former U.S. President Donald Trump in redefining international dynamics. This period marked a crucial phase for India-US relations amid a rapidly changing world landscape.

articles.title: Lawmaker gives Trump nominee tongue-lashing after he dodges key question: 'You're afraid!'
articles.summary: During a US confirmation hearing, Democratic Senator Tim Kaine sharply criticized a Trump nominee who refused to respond to questions. This exchange underscores the political confrontations and challenges concerning transparency in government appointments within the American system. For SSB aspirants, this offers insight into international democratic processes and accountability mechanisms in major global powers.
